title: Patient Financial Services Worksheet: Pre-Service Estimate for a Study at a New Site
content:
The pre-service estimate a patient signs for when an Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization or an Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization under Referrals & Prior Authorizations is moved to another site is the specialist copay recorded on the patient's financial account.

## Calculation

1. **The study.** The estimate is for the study booked against the authorization, at the new site and on that study's scheduled date.
2. **The amount.** The amount asked of the patient at check-in for that study is the specialist copay recorded on the patient's Patient Financial Account, in US dollars.
3. **The figure signed for.** The estimate signed for is that amount, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical accounts)

| Specialist copay recorded on the account | Estimate signed for |
|---|---|
| 45.00 | 45.00 |
| 60.00 | 60.00 |
| 0.00 | 0.00 |

A specialist copay of 45.00 dollars gives an estimate of 45.00: the copay is already stated to the cent, so the rounding leaves it unchanged, and it is not below zero.

## Form of the figure

The estimate is written in dollars with exactly two decimal places and no currency sign, so 45 dollars is written 45.00.
